notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hello, Players![/p][p][/p][p]We've released [b]Hotfix 1.1.2[/b] to address some bugs and inconveniences in the game. [/p][p]Simply restart your Steam client and the update will be applied automatically.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added "View Supporter Credits" option in the Credits screen[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted to obtain slightly more Golden Barley[/p][/*][*][p]Added customizable key bindings[/p][/*][*][p]Various convenience improvements for boss battles[/p][/*][*][p]Other bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please share your thoughts and feedback on Steam discussions or reviews! [/p][p]Your feedback means a lot to us.[/p][p]We'll continue to do our best to provide a stable and enjoyable gaming experience![/p]

notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hello, players![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve released [b]Hotfix 1.1.1[/b] to address several bugs and inconveniences in the game.[/p][p]Please restart your Steam client to apply the update automatically.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased jump height[/p][/*][*][p]Increased running speed[/p][/*][*][p]Improved interaction detection[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened the display time of the material acquisition UI popup[/p][/*][*][p]You can now move while certain dialogue balloons are displayed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting our game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also preparing additional updates, so please feel free to share your feedback or reviews in the Steam Discussions or Review section—we’ll make sure to read them carefully.[/p][p]We’ll continue working hard to provide you with a stable and enjoyable gameplay experience![/p]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam!
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]<Medi-Cooker> is now officially released on Steam![/b] [/p][p]You can download and start playing right now.[/p][p][/p][p]The game supports Korean, English, and Simplified Chinese.[/p][p]Begin your special journey with your little cat companion today![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3480030"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Medi-Cooker will be officially released on August 8!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513632/5b0ee0a15362635f5b20cedd713d6f5c0134ddce.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello,[/p][p]We're happy to finally announce the official release date of [i]Medi-Cooker[/i]![/p][p][i]Medi-Cooker[/i] will be officially released on [b]Friday, August 8th, 2025 at 6 PM (KST)[/b] on Steam.[/p][p]The game will support Korean, English, and Simplified Chinese.[/p][p][/p][p]August 8th is [b]International Cat Day[/b], a day to reflect on the presence and importance of cats in our lives.
We hope the small cat companion who journeys with you in the game will feel a little more special on this meaningful day.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has shown interest and support so far.
We hope you’ll continue to look forward to the release and enjoy the experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
